_note: Golden aggregates for axilog WvW parity. Task 3 (M2): squadAppliedCrowdControl(Duration)/squadStunBreak/squadRemovedStunDuration are sums of statsAll[0].appliedCrowdControl(Duration) / support[0].stunBreak(removedStunDuration) over all 41 players; per-player appliedCrowdControl/appliedCrowdControlDuration/stunBreak/removedStunDuration below are the same source fields joined by account. Task 5 (M2): player[].account values were regenerated to `Anon<N>.<4 digits>` (N = raw agent-table index, same deterministic formula as `axilog_core::evtc::anon_account`) so they equal what `fixtures/wvw-small.anon.zevtc` (committed, PII-safe) decodes to at that same index — the real .zevtc stays local-only, gitignored, PII, never committed. The old->new mapping for this one-time regeneration was derived by joining each real account's sha256-based EI-obfuscated form (still present as `ei_account_obfuscation` in `crates/axilog-cli/tests/cli.rs`, kept as a historical/standalone-tested reference) to its raw agent-table index. The `professions_match_ei_golden` test itself now joins purely by raw agent-table index (via `anon_account(i)`), which works identically against the committed anon fixture or the real local one. 4 rows keep their original `Non Squad Player N` placeholder account (EI's own label for non-squad players present in the encounter but outside the recorded squad) since they never had a real account to map from. Task 2 (M3): each player's `boons` object holds the 12 tracked-boon skill ids (see `axilog_core::analysis::buffs::BOON_IDS`) -> EI's raw `buffUptimes[].buffData[0]` `{uptime, presence}` pair, verbatim (0/0 when the id is absent from the source `buffUptimes` array, i.e. the player never held that buff at all). EI's own field meaning differs by boon stack type (verified directly from these numbers, e.g. player Anon132.5884's Might=740 uptime=7.808/presence=88.962 vs Fury=725 uptime=68.459/presence=0): for DURATION-type boons (everything except Might=740/Stability=1122) `uptime` IS the presence percentage (0-100) and `presence` is always 0/unused; for INTENSITY-type boons (Might, Stability) `uptime` is the time-weighted average stack count and `presence` is the presence percentage (0-100). This asymmetry is exactly what the M3 Task 2 brief flagged and what `boons_golden.rs` decodes per-boon via `BOON_IDS`'s `is_intensity` flag. Same real-account join method as Task 5's account regeneration (obfuscate(real account) -> raw agent-table index -> `Anon<N>`), cross-checked against 3 independent fields (profession, `dpsAll[0].damage`, `statsAll[0].appliedCrowdControl`) for all 41 players with zero mismatches before trusting the join for `boons`.
